title: RTX 5060 Ti 16GB - 25 Games Tested at 4k
description:
In this video, I pushed the RTX 5060 Ti to its limits at 3840x2160 (4K) resolution across 25 games. As expected, native 4K is out of reach for most modern AAA titles — but DLSS 4 upscaling and Frame Generation made several games surprisingly playable.

📌 DLSS Performance/Balanced modes were used where needed, and in some cases I enabled DLSS x4 Multi-Frame Generation. I didn’t notice any major latency issues from Frame Generation—the responsiveness felt acceptable for me but quality losses are noticeable if you watch carefully...

💡 Overall, the RTX 5060 Ti isn't a true 4K card, but with DLSS 4 and 16GB VRAM, it's capable of delivering a solid 4K experience in select games with the right settings.

Watch the 1080p Test: https://youtu.be/XWsjCWI5p3E
